summary: Full verification of the new 'Bank Data' perangkat auto-detect feature. Backend GET /api/perangkat/bank/lookup validated across seeded cases (12-char fallback, 13-char match, ambiguous multi-name, unknown prefix, and <11-char guard). Learning path verified: creating a workorder with a brand-new nama+nomor persists to db.perangkat_bank and subsequent lookups auto-suggest. Frontend PerangkatEditor tested inside a real PSB/INSTALASI Work Order form -> auto-fill + 'Terdeteksi otomatis' hint, and amber options dropdown for ambiguous prefix work as specified. 8/8 backend pytest cases pass; 2/2 frontend flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3232 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, workorders, invoices, perangkat, attachments) for maintainability.

perangkat_bank_lookup returns the same prefix for the first non-empty length only (as designed for longest-prefix), which is correct; consider a compound index {prefix:1, plen:1} already exists (line 399) — good.
_learn_perangkat writes 3 rows per item (L=11/12/13) — acceptable but be aware the collection grows 3x per unique nomor.
test_credentials: admin / admin123 (username login; also operator/operator, guest/guest)
seed_data_creation: Test created workorder with nama='TEST DEVICE XYZ' nomor='QWERTYUIOP123456' to prove learning; workorder deleted afterwards but the learned bank entry stays (by design — bank is cumulative). Also a lingering PSB workorder from prior iteration_1 test may exist.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login form uses ROLE radio buttons (labels 'Admin'/'Operator'/'Guest') + password only; no username input. Use `page.get_by_text('Admin', exact=True).click()` then `[data-testid=login-submit-button]`. To reach PerangkatEditor: /workorders/new -> jenis-pick-PSB -> fase-pick-INSTALASI -> fill Nama Pelanggan + SA ID (else Hasil Pekerjaan section is locked) -> click 'Hasil Pekerjaan' section link -> [data-testid=perangkat-add-btn]. Bank lookup is debounced (~300ms). WorkOrder 'bw' is a string in the API (not int).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in Bank Data feature.
